notes.title: 2.12.2 Game modifiers and challenges
notes.content:
2.12.1 this version brings more challenges, more options and hopefully more fun

- Modifiers 
- All 6 players can play in the same team against AI

Players can setup some game properties for example
- life/damage of creeps
- quantity/damage of cores ( ma favourite )
- respawn time
- if is jungle active
- You can setup starting level per player
and more

When Modifiers are active
- certain heroes can be used multiple times!!! ( Interceptor/whiskers/treasure hunter and more)
- the final XP are reduced by 50% and there is a cap 5k per match
- If the "Core quantity" is not default then the XP from collecting them doesn't count (as this could be exploited)
- Up to 10 AI can be on each side


Change log
- Fixed floor collider in "Space port"
- Fixed Azure's level 20 bonus not working
- Azure doesn't gain hp regeneration from towers and Golem (if it is idle)
- Azure's hp regeneration is now limited to max 50/100/150 ( based on the level)
- Added option to disable haptics
- Reduce the damage of Rail gun, but increased the ammo rechargins speed
- AI is improved and little bit more agressive ( based on their dificulty they try to avoid Dragon Slave. In Eden if they reach a tower that can't be destroyed, they change lines

Challenges

Players can activate time challenges, these challenges is a combination of
User players / AI players / AI bonus levels 
your goal is to win as fast as possible. Based on your winning time you will be placed on the ranking board

For each combination there is a ranking board so you can play with your friends and try to beat the current best time, for now there is no XP reward if you are first since the boards are empty, but I will look into this

As always with big update comes ocasional bugs so report them as soon as you see them and I will try to fix the most urgent one before the weekend ( if there are some)

Change log

 - Fixed when Azure jump multipple times
 - Fixed when Azure's lightning would be triggered on each client -> 4 users playing together = 4x time the actual damage
 - Storm activation takes 2 seconds instead of immediate activation
 - Fixed grappe projectile audio not being positional
 - Fixed when jup landing wouldn't slow down creeps
 - Add Jump Effect and grapple "in the air effect"
 - Fixed Azur's grapple gun having incorrect model on quest

notes.title: WoT Qualifiers
notes.content:
Please note, the F2P version can collect qualifier points, but only the paid version will have the right to compete, if a user buys the full version they will keep the qualifier points collected in the F2P version.

Qualifiers

Welcome to the Qualifiers. Over the next month, everyone will have a chance to play the game to collect Qualifier Points. 
If you earn enough points you will have a chance to gain access to the Tournament with a prize pool of over $1,000

- The total prize pool will grow during the Qualifiers with a portion of the sales from people who buy the game.
That's right if you buy Champions of Titus during this time a portion of that money will go into the prize pool!

1st place team --> 50% of the total prize
2nd place team -> 25% of the total prize
3nd place team -> 10% of the total prize
4th place team ---> 5% of the total prize
5th place team ---> 5% of the total prize
6th place team ---> 5% of the total prize

- To qualify for the tournament, you need to earn at least 200 points by playing "Qualifier games"
- Qualifiers will star sometime at the end of January, will last about a month and the tournament will start up shortly after.

Once Qualified:
-You have to join the Discord to stay in communication with everyone involved to schedule events.
- If you want to compete for the prize pool, you will need a PayPal account (players who don't have PayPal will get an amazon gift card).
- You will need to agree to the conditions (to be finalized before the start of the tournament).
- You will need to create a team of 3 users that all qualified. If you can't form a team of 3, you will be offered a random team slot on a still open team, if available.
- To determine the starting places on the brackets for each team, your total Qualifier Points between all 3 team members will help slot you in the brackets. 
- Once the tournament starts the times undetermined yet, but they should be some common times between EU and US. Most likely weekends.
